title: DeepMind&\#x27;s AlphaProof Code brings AI to formal verification, scope questioned
summary: DeepMind has introduced AlphaProof Code, an AI system for formal code verification, according to the company&\#x27;s announcement. The item supplied here contains no article text, benchmark results, version or availability details, or independent measurements, so the strength and breadth of the proofs it produces remain unestablished. The announcement drew substantial Hacker News discussion centered on what such proofs actually guarantee.
